title: Problematic
text:
Problematic. Okay, here's the good:
*Great design. It fits in your hand and has a handy hook so you can hang it up. It's as cute as a bug. In fact it looks like a little gray beetle.
*The cutter end is fantastic. It's almost worth it just for that. You can open bags in a flash.
Here's the not so hot:
If you use the two batteries that come with it, chances are, it won't ever get hot. They're duds.
If you follow the markings on the gadget--the giant plus and minus signs--it won't get hot either. Press down on the sealing end, and nothing happens. Nothing.
I took a chance and put the batteries in the way you do on a flashlight--alternate plus and minus, and it heated up right away and sealed both light and heavier bags (after a bit of experimentation--you have to move it across the bag at a moderately fast even rate.) This was definitely NOT what I was directed to do and I'm not sure it was right, so I'm not recommending it, even if it did work.

Bottom line--er--great idea, and possibly a useful gadget, but needs better batteries and MUCH better instructions.
